title: Derived exponential bijection for simplicial projective diagrams
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and their model homotopy category $h\mathrm{sCat}$ from [lem-coef-simplicial-inversion-universal-property], and combinatorial simplicial model categories, enriched projective diagrams and objectwise evaluation from [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a combinatorial simplicial model category and let $I,D$ be small simplicial categories. Write $\mathcal A^D$ for enriched functors $D\to\mathcal A$ with enriched natural transformations and its projective model structure. Let $\mathcal B=(\mathcal A^D)^{cf}$ and $\mathcal A^{cf}$ be the full simplicial subcategories of cofibrant fibrant objects. Cartesian products of simplicial categories have paired objects, product mapping simplicial sets and componentwise composition. Enriched evaluation defines $e:\mathcal B\times D\to\mathcal A^{cf}$. All displayed categories and hom sets are contained in suitably enlarged universes.

The assignment $[g]\mapsto[e\circ(g\times1_D)]$ gives a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{h\mathrm{sCat}}(I,\mathcal B)\ \cong\ \operatorname{Hom}_{h\mathrm{sCat}}(I\times D,\mathcal A^{cf}),$$
natural under enriched restriction in $I$ and derived enriched restriction in $D$. For a set $S$ of vertex arrows of $I$, this bijection identifies the subset of classes sending every $s\in S$ to an isomorphism in $\pi_0\mathcal B$ with the subset sending every $(s,1_d)$, $s\in S$, $d\in\operatorname{Ob}D$, to an isomorphism in $\pi_0\mathcal A^{cf}$. Equivalently a vertex enriched natural transformation between projectively cofibrant fibrant $D$-diagrams is invertible in $\pi_0\mathcal B$ exactly when each object component is invertible in $\pi_0\mathcal A^{cf}$. No cofibrancy or local Kan condition is imposed on $I,D$.

source.place: Propositions A.3.4.12-A.3.4.13, printed pp.889-890. The subset clause is the objectwise weak-equivalence criterion in the projective model, used in the third bijection of the proof of Lemma A.3.5.14, printed p.896; bifibrant diagram equivalences are tested in the model homotopy category. Read online 2026-10-17; archival HTT WANTED. No Stacks tag states this enriched homotopy-theoretic result.
